Manager note – Batch B-1112 Bradford (LC-3):

Result: NOT RELEASED – run failed QC, no results released.

Work done:
- Head check `lh verify` found channel 6 (row F) -3 uL low at 100 uL (out of +/-2 uL). Set `lh calibrate 6 +3.02`, re-verified pass at 100, 10 and 250 uL.
- Ran validated method bradford.json on PL1, `reader read`, `assay qc`: R2 0.9997 PASS, but all 8 controls ~-24% (CTRL-L ~187-198 vs 250, CTRL-H ~565-573 vs 750) – FAIL +/-15%.
- Repeated on PL2 to confirm: R2 0.9999, controls -23 to -27%, samples reproduce PL1 within ~2% (e.g. S1 340.5/340.5, S4 742.5/743.1). Reproducible systematic bias, not random pipetting. `assay release` correctly refused for both plates.

Interpretation: Head is now accurate and execution is reproducible. Failure affects both control levels equally, with excellent curve, pointing to calibrator vs control lot mismatch – STD lot S-230 (old, unchanged) vs new CTRL lot C-121 – e.g. STD concentrated by evaporation or C-121 mis-made/dilute. Cannot fix by recalibration.

Integrity: Followed SOP/validated method only. Did not edit /data/reader files and did not make controls from STD stock per logbook warnings.

Recommendation: Hold B-1112 samples (S1-S8 unreleased), quarantine/check STD S-230 and CTRL C-121 lots (fresh vials, independent assay), then re-run. I do not consider the cell ready for unattended runs until the lot issue is resolved.

"""Workcell client library (runs inside the operator workstation).

Every cell tool (robot, station, and the station-specific tools) talks to the cell controller over a Unix socket.
Command line:  robot locate B1      Python:  import workcell; r = workcell.call("robot", "locate", "B1"); print(r.text)
Results carry .ok (bool), .text (what the command line prints) and .data (structured values, when the command has any).
"""
import json
import socket
import sys

SOCKET_PATH = "/run/workcell/cell.sock"


class Result:
    def __init__(self, d):
        self.ok = d.get("code", 1) == 0
        self.code = d.get("code", 1)
        self.text = d.get("text", "")
        self.data = d.get("data") or {}

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Result(ok={self.ok}, text={self.text!r}, data={self.data!r})"


def call(tool, *args, timeout=600):
    """Send one command to the cell controller and wait for its result."""
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(timeout)
    try:
        s.connect(SOCKET_PATH)
    except OSError as e:
        return Result({"code": 2, "text": f"{tool}: cell controller not reachable ({e})"})
    req = json.dumps({"tool": tool, "argv": [str(a) for a in args]}) + "\n"
    s.sendall(req.encode())
    buf = b""
    while not buf.endswith(b"\n"):
        chunk = s.recv(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        buf += chunk
    s.close()
    try:
        return Result(json.loads(buf.decode()))
    except ValueError:
        return Result({"code": 2, "text": f"{tool}: malformed reply from cell controller"})


def robot(*args):
    return call("robot", *args)


def cli(tool):
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    as_json = False
    if "--json" in args:
        as_json = True
        args = [a for a in args if a != "--json"]
    r = call(tool, *args)
    if as_json:
        print(json.dumps({"ok": r.ok, "text": r.text, "data": r.data}))
    elif r.text:
        print(r.text)
    sys.exit(r.code)

Result: NOT RELEASED – run failed QC, no results released.

Work done:
- Head check `lh verify` found channel 6 (row F) -3 uL low at 100 uL (out of +/-2 uL). Set `lh calibrate 6 +3.02`, re-verified pass at 100, 10 and 250 uL.
